pr_title: Fix tests modifying static ListenOptions member data
pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/issues/23043

Two things I haven't figured out yet:
1. Who is modifying the ListenOptions and is that a bug?
1. ~~How is the second test runs' client hitting the first test runs' "app"?~~ ListenOptions has the app func inside it
pr_comments: Sadly I was mistaken and `Repeat` failed me by preserving the `TheoryData` instead of re-instantiating it per test.
You didn't have to close this! It at least gets rid of some non-serializable test data warnings 😄
